SOFTWARE ENGINEER, GROUND SYSTEMS




THE COMPANY

AnySignal is developing the next generation of RF products and services for some of the most demanding space and defense missions. We’re building a flexible, high-performance platform that’s easy to deploy, monitor, and scale, enabling customers to bring advanced radio technologies to life faster than ever before.




THE ROLE

We’re hiring a Software Engineer to develop the software that connects, operates, and scales our ground network.

This role sits at the intersection of software, networking, and cloud infrastructure. You will build distributed services that connect ground stations, cloud infrastructure, and customer-facing systems, while helping ensure the network remains reliable, observable, and scalable as it grows.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Design, develop, and operate software that supports AnySignal’s ground network across cloud and edge environments

 - Build backend services and APIs used to operate and manage the software and hardware that delivers data from ground stations to customers

 - Deploy and operate containerized services using Kubernetes

 - Build software that analyzes and optimizes links between spacecraft and the ground

 - Write software that handles configuration and data handling for a variety of ground radios

 - Build and maintain logging, monitoring, and observability infrastructure across the fleet

 - Troubleshoot software, networking, and infrastructure issues across cloud and deployed hardware environments

 - Contribute to system architecture as the ground network scales across additional stations and infrastructure

 - Work cross-functionally with ground hardware, RF, space software, and other engineering teams
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must-Haves:

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field

 - Strong software engineering experience in Python, Go, or a similar programming language

 - Strong experience developing and operating software on Linux

 - Experience building backend services, APIs, or distributed systems

 - Experience developing and operating software in AWS or similar cloud environments

 - Strong understanding of networking fundamentals and protocols, including TCP/IP

 - Experience troubleshooting network connectivity and distributed software systems

 - Experience with logging, monitoring, observability, and production software reliability

 - Experience with automated testing and software validation

 - Ability to work independently and take ownership in a fast-moving engineering environment
   
   

Preferred Qualifications:

 - Experience deploying and operating containerized applications using Kubernetes

 - Experience with satellite ground systems, satellite communications, or telecommunications infrastructure

 - Experience developing software deployed across both cloud and edge environments

 - Experience with scheduling, orchestration, or resource-management systems

 - Experience developing software that interfaces with or operates physical infrastructure

 - Understanding of electrical, RF, networking, or communications systems

 - Experience working in an early-stage or high-growth engineering environment




COMPENSATION

The estimated base salary range for this role is $130,000-$200,000 per year, plus equity. This range reflects our good-faith estimate for this position at the time of posting. The final base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, skills, and market considerations.

In addition to base salary and equity, AnySignal offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) program, competitive paid time off, and paid parental leave.




EXPORT CONTROL REQUIREMENTS

To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including ITAR, applicants must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the necessary authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

AnySignal is committed to building an inclusive and accessible workplace where all employees feel respected, supported, and able to contribute fully. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, including women, veterans, individuals with disabilities, and members of underrepresented communities.

If you require accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please contact us in confidence at careers@anysignal.com. We are committed to ensuring equal access for all applicants.
